title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-dk3c.5: TOCTOU race in dodag_loss_resume_handler
description:
## Description

In  (), the handler reads  under the mutex (line 707) but releases the lock before calling  (line 712). Between the unlock and  re-acquiring the lock, a concurrent call to  could change  back to . The handler would then schedule the GATEWAY interval instead of the intended NORMAL interval.

Additionally,  schedules the loss-resume timer outside the mutex (lines 744-752). A concurrent call could change  between the unlock and , causing a spurious timer.

## Impact
- Transient: after DODAG loss, if the node rapidly rejoins before  acquires the lock, the timer fires and incorrectly schedules the next announce at the GATEWAY interval
- Under heavy load with rapid DODAG join/leave cycles, the announce interval may be left in the wrong state

## Files
-  - dodag_loss_resume_handler
-  - timer scheduling outside mutex

## Fix
- Pass the resolved interval to  instead of having it re-read the state
- Or hold the mutex across the full timer schedule in 
- Or re-check  inside the mutex after  completes
